overview.about: The World Sauna Forum is the leading international gathering for the sauna and wellness industry, held in Finland - the sauna's spiritual home. It brings together designers, manufacturers, spa operators and researchers to share ideas on the future of sauna culture and wellbeing.
overview.nextEvent: The next World Sauna Forum is held in Jyvaskyla, Finland, combining a conference programme with an exhibition and sauna experiences. It connects the global sauna industry around design, health and business.

affiliateDisclosure: OneSliders may earn a commission from sponsored booking links, at no extra cost to you.
airportTransfer: Use Jyväskylä Airport as the first flight-planning reference, then check the current route to Jyväskylä before booking transport.
arrivalWindow: Arrive before your first planned sauna session, especially if you need to check in, change, collect wristbands or move between venues.
flightTip: Compare arrival times against sauna-session times; late arrivals are awkward when sessions, competitions or guided rounds run on fixed slots.
stayGuidance: Stay close to Jyväskylä if you want easier access between sessions, evening heat rounds and cold-water activities.
transportTip: Check local transport before the event day
transportDetail: Confirm the route between your stay area and Jyväskylä; sauna events can involve wet gear, robes, towels or extra recovery clothing.
eventDayTip: Pack for heat and cool-down time
eventDayDetail: Bring swimwear or sauna clothing where required, sandals, a towel, water and a dry layer for after the final session.
